StageAttention: Blood mist gnaws at the broken branches of memory. Lost in her old home and unable to hold on to the past, the girl keeps watch over a promise she has already forgotten.
Margaret leaps up, spins while charging her scepter, then fires a beam straight ahead when the charge is complete.

Margaret gathers energy at the tip of her scepter and strikes the target. After spinning up for lift, she follows with a stronger attack, then rises higher and slams down, releasing all energy at the impact point and causing wooden spikes to burst out.
Margaret retreats to create space, then fires an energy shot at the target from the peak of her jump.

Margaret empowers her wings and launches two parryable strikes at her target. The first comes from her right. She then spins once and attacks from the left. If the second strike is successfully parried, Margaret is knocked backward by recoil and fires an energy projectile. Parry the projectile to knock Margaret out of the air.

Margaret leaps into the air and briefly charges up. She gathers energy into her scepter, forming a glowing orb, then thrusts toward her target to attack. Root-like projections from the orb launch the target into the air. After the orb explodes, Margaret uses the recoil to push herself further back.

Margaret leaps into the air and dives toward her target, attempting to grab them. If successful, she slams them into the ground and charges her scepter for an explosive blast, launching them into the air.

Margaret taps the ground with her scepter, marking a circular area of golden thorns beneath the target. After a short delay, roots erupt from the center and launch the target into the air. She places this trap by tracking the target's movements.
